senses.gloss:
वघा वघा, f., Ved. a kind of noxious
animal.

वाघत् वाघत्, त्, m. (according to some fr.
rt. 1. वह्, probably Pres. part. of a lost rt. वाघ् = Lat.
vāgire, Gr. εὔχομαι), Ved. praying; a priest (ac-
cording to Naigh. III. 18 = ऋत्विज्); = मेधाविन्
(Naigh. III. 15); a horse, (Sāy. = वाहक = अश्व).
वाघेल्ल वाघेल्ल, N. of a family.
